scientific_content_identity.meaning: The v4 qualification branch and work/ribasim-dummy-01 contain identical scientific DUMMY-19C executable/preregistered content.

evidence: Both priority cases allocate the full 40 m3/day root demand and 20 m3/day external demand.
Direct physical Basin-to-UserDemand supply is reduced to approximately half of allocation by the pinned min_level reduction law.
Root and external physical supplied volumes remain in an exact 2:1 common-factor ratio within preregistered tolerances.
Priority reversal leaves allocation, physical supplied split and Basin trajectory unchanged in this fully allocated common-factor case.
60 m3 fixed inflow closes as physical UserDemand supply plus Basin storage gain within the preregistered 0.05 m3 tolerance.
interpretation: Pinned real Ribasim distinguishes management allocation from physical realization. In the deliberately controlled common-source/common-min_level case, both demands are fully allocated but physical supply is reduced by the same source-state factor, so the realized split remains proportional and is independent of priority order. Allocated-but-unsupplied volume is not a physical transfer.
boundaries: result applies only to one common source Basin with equal UserDemand min_level values
no claim that proportional physical reduction generalizes to unequal min_level values or different source Basins
no network reallocation after physical shortfall
downstream: DUMMY-19D may now be rebound and implemented to falsify common-factor proportionality using unequal UserDemand min_level values under the same pinned real Ribasim authority.
